Subject: Ulvara Grill Holdings - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Ulvara Grill Holdings.

I need to refer this one to our senior underwriting team before we can proceed with a quote. Here's why:

• The location falls within our coastal exposure zone (within 16 km of coast)
• We're managing accumulation in this area—our existing portfolio concentration is already high within 25 km
• The five-year loss history shows losses exceeding $250K

I'll escalate this internally and circle back within 2-3 business days. If our appetite doesn't align, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty coastal property market, one that focuses on these exposures.

I'll be in touch soon!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
